chapters: Jano' ba' gu takarui' jix bhai'x oi'ñga' gook gu Dariio ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tasi' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu mar gu Berekîas gu mar gu Iddo bham.
Jano' ba' bhaam gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx daak bhaan tattat.
Jano' ba' daipu'; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ tu' gu jodai' bhaan tu' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.

Jano' ba' cham ka't na ja'p tattat jix maa jiiñak dharka' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan bham; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jano' tomaat gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ buimɨi; jano' ba' cham jix duñia' tu' jix duñia' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tattat duukat jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan jix duñia' duaka' na ba' bɨɨx tas.

Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n jix aa'ñdhix tu duukam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan cham jix duñia' tattat gu ux gu ñi'ook suulh gui'p; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ jix duñia' gu chuukug jurtu'nka' gu bhóogɨt jurtu'nka' gu bhóogɨt buimɨi jix duu bɨɨx no'ch.
Jano' ba' maakob gu takarui' gu tasi' gu takarui' gu Sebat oi'ñga' gook gu Dariio ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tasi' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu mar gu Berekîas gu mar gu Iddo bham.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tukaa' gu suudai' gu chio'ñ jix duñia' bhaan kavaayo gu ñi'ook ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kavɨk ka't gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' gu suudai' ka't jix duñia' gu takarui' gu chuukug jix toja.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook suulhgia' gu Jawatan gu chuukug jix aa' nobii'ñ ua'rgidhimɨk gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr tu' gu ñi'ook suulhgia'.
Ba' jix aa' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kavɨk; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx ja'k jiim gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kavɨk gui'p; gio ba' gu jodai' bɨx ja'k jiim gu oidha' gu suudai' bɨx gu oidha' gu bhóogɨt gu ux.

Ba' jix aa' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ bɨɨx ka'm duuk cham gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu Jerusalem jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa bɨɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' jix bhai' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' mii' dhɨr nobii'ñ ua'rgidhimɨk gu chuukug.
Ba' jix aa' nobii'ñ ua'rgidhimɨk gu chuukug; gio ba' duuñ bham; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem gu Sioon bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx jix gɨ' gu duukam dhi' gu ñi'ook bhaan chɨbɨɨp gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na gu' tu' ka't jix bhai'x gu vaak u'ua'tɨdham na ba' cham bhai'.

Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu Jerusalem bɨɨx gu jodai'; mi' dhɨr ka't gu jodai' gu vaak tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu jodai' ka't gu oi'ñga'n bhaan gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' duuñ gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' ka't gu takarui' jɨ'dɨlh gu ux gu tasi' xoi'kam; jano' ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Sioon gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu chuukug gu vupui gu chuukug gu suudai' maakobh a'aa'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook nobii'ñ ua'rgidhimɨk gu chuukug; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n suulhgia' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam a'aa' gu ñi'ook gu Judaa gu Israeel gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios maakobh gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n jupaabkamu'n suulhgia' a'ga jix aa' bham; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam a'aa' gu ñi'ook gu Judaa gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' mo'o; gu' suulhgia' jix duñia' tɨbiap na ba' jix duñia' gu chuukug na ba' gu o'o a'aa' chɨbɨɨp jix duñia' gu suudai' bhaan gu oidha' gu Judaa na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug mi' dhɨr gu vupui gu chuukug gu suudai' gu chio'ñ ga'ra' gu novɨ gu duukam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' duukat gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jerusalem na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu kutun gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' busaak mii' dhɨr nobii'ñ ua'rgidhimɨk gu chuukug nobii'ñ jix buus gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu suudai' tu ñi'ook dhi' gu takarui' bham; mi' dhɨr cham vaak jodai ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jerusalem kuiñcha gu oi'ñga'n gu chichio'ñ gu vaakax tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' na ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios vaak jodai gu tai gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu ux gɇ'kamtu'nda' tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' gu takarui' gu oidha' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ux maakobh jɨbɨɨlh gu tɨkɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Sioon jix koi bɨɨx mar u'vɨ gu Babiloonia gu oi'ñga'n.
Na gu' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' mi' dhɨr gɇ'kamtu'nda' jix duñia' chɨbɨɨp jix duñia'; na gu' gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' gu suudai' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu novɨ bhaan ka't gu takarui' tu duukam gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ bhañ.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug mar u'vɨ gu Sioon; na gu' gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt jix koi tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' maa'n mumua'da' chɨbɨɨp gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh ka't gu ux gu ja'tkam jix koi tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'; gio ba' jano' ba' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt gu Judaa gu maa'nkar gu oidha' abhaar gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu vaak bɨx gu chuukug vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ abhaar jix koi.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Josuee jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ka't vupui bhaan nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Sataan ka't gu novɨ tu jiim na ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Sataan; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu Sataan; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tasi' gu Jerusalem tu' gu oi'ñga'n; jano' ba' cham gu ux gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu Josuee ka't tɨi'chu' gu bhóogɨt ka't vupui bhaan nobii'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' nobii'ñ jix duñia' mi'p vupui bhaan bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook kutun gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' mi' dhɨr; gio ba' gu suudai' gu takarui' na jix bhai' bhaan mo'o; mi' dhɨr jix dhaas gu takarui' bhaan mo'o jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n; jano' ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Josuee bham.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' tu' jiim gu ux gu bhóogɨt tu' gu ñi'ook jir bɨx bhai' gio tu' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu vaak gio tu' nukadham gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' ja'tkam tu' gu suudai' ɨrban.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug jano' gu Josuee jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' vupui bhaan tu'; na gu' gu chichio'ñ gu oi'ñga'n; mi' dhɨr gu Miren tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu duukam gu oi'ñga'n.

Na gu' na gu' gu suudai' mii' dhɨr gu jodai gu takarui' vupui bhaan gu Josuee; gio ba' bhaan dhi' gu ñi'ook gu jodai cham tu'x jai'ch kɨɨv gu vupui; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' tu' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu jodai' uañi'ñ gu oidha' gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ maa'n gu takarui' tɨɨt duiñchu' bɨtaa'n gu tasi' bɨtaa'n iigɨx.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' nobii'ñ ua'rgidhimɨk gu chuukug jix duñia' na ja'p gu chio'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ koox.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu jiim gu suudai' mɨichdhai bɨx jix uam jodai bɨɨx vaaso bhaan mo'o kɨɨv tɨtɨɨya tu jiim mɨichdhai; jano' ba' kɨɨv gu duukam na ba' tɨtɨɨya tu jiim.
Jano' ba' bhaan gook gu ñi'ook tu jiim vaaso o'nsop.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' tu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr nobii'ñ ua'rgidhimɨk gu chuukug bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu Jawatan gu chuukug.
Ba' jix aa' nobii'ñ ua'rgidhimɨk gu chuukug; gio ba' cham ñɨidhat gu ñi'ook dhi' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham gu Jawatan gu chuukug.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Sorobabeel tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham bɨɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham tu' bɨɨx gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' chɨkka gu chuukug tu' gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk vupui bhaan gu Sorobabeel ka' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu jodai bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Grakia nɨidhidha'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' bham.
Jano' ba' gu noobh gu Sorobabeel mi'x juu'ñ gu ñi'ook dhi' gu vaak gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ bhañ bhaan.
Na gu' na gu' jix duñia' gu tanoolh gu chuukug jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' gu novɨ gu Sorobabeel; gio ba' mii' dhɨr kɨɨv gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios bɨx ja'k jiim gu ux bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' dhi' gook gu ñi'ook tu jiim mɨichdhai o'nsop.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt jix vɨɨk; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gook mamraga'n gu ñi'ook gu ux tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook gu oi'ñga'n jix uam jodai gu takarui' bɨ'ñdhatu' na ja'p jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' jix aa' bham; gio ba' cham ñɨidhat gu ñi'ook dhi' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan gu chuukug cham.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam gook gu ma'nkam bɨ'ñdhatu' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug gu vupui gu chuukug gu suudai' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu jodai' gu ja'tkam da'a gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' mambhɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' dhi' mu'ai gu chuukug bhaan gu vupui bɨx gu oidha'; na gu' bɨx mii' dhɨr jix duñia' na ja'p baasɨ'n gu takarui' ka't gu jodai'; jano' ba' bɨx mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook na ja'p baasɨ'n gu takarui' ka't gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ ɨlhdham gu vaak ɨxkum gu vaak gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu tɨɨgɨ'; gio ba' gu suudai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak gu takarui' bɨɨx gu jodai' gu jodai.
Ba' jix aa' jix buus mii' dhɨr nobii'ñ ua'rgidhimɨk gu chuukug; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jano' gu vupui gu suudai' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix aa'; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu Epa gu chuukug; jano' ba' gu suudai' jix aa'; gio ba' dhi' gu vupui bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gɨ' maa'nkar jodai gu ja'tkam gu u'vɨ ka't gu oi'ñga'n tɨjɨɨ'ñ mii' dhɨr gu Epa.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' dhi' gu i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Epa jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu chin.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu vupui gu chuukug gu suudai' gook gu u'vɨ jix buus gu ñi'ook gu jɨvɨl gu oi'ñga'n ko'kmarak gu oi'ñga'n na ja'p gu chuukug jix duñia' gu Epa tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook nobii'ñ ua'rgidhimɨk gu chuukug; gio ba' duukat gu ux na tu ibai' gu Epa.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; na ba' ka't gu jodai' gu vaak gu oidha' gu Sinar; mi' dhɨr ka't gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug gu vupui gu chuukug gu suudai' maakobh gu bhóogɨt jix buus tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook gu kakkavɨk; gio ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu kakkavɨk jix duñia' gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' maa'n gu bhóogɨt ka't kavaayo gu takarui' gook gu bhóogɨt kavaayo gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' vaik gu bhóogɨt kavaayo jix toja maakobh gu bhóogɨt kavaayo gu chuukug gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook jano' ba' nobii'ñ gu chuukug ua'rgidhimɨk; gio ba' gu Jawatan gu chuukug gu ñi'ook dhi'.
Ba' jix aa' nobii'ñ; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam maakobh jɨbɨɨlh gu tɨkɨr gɨgɨ'lhi'ñ pai' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' mi'p kavaayo gu chuukug moor bhaan gu oidha' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix toja moor bhaan; mi' dhɨr gu chuukug moor bhaan gu oidha' saagi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' moor jix duñia' gu ux tu' bɨx ja'k jiim gu oidha'; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt bɨx ja'k jiim gu oidha'; jano' ba' bɨx ja'k jiim pai'.
Ba' jix aa' jup tɨɨt bham; gio ba' gu Mira moor bhaan gu oidha' gu ñi'ook jix duu gu ñi'ook gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu oidha' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' gu Toma gu ñi'ook gu eldai gu Tobiias gu Jedaiia suulh gu Babiloonia; gio ba' ɨlhdham tu' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh ba'k gu vaak gu Josiiyas gu mar gu Sepaniias.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ jix toja jodai jix uam jodai jix duu gu jodai' na jix uam gu bhóogɨt mo'o jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Josuee gu mar gu Josadak.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ bham; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu chio'ñ gu tɨɨgɨ' gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' pai' gu ñi'ook vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gɇ'kamtu'nda' jix duñia' atooxkor ka't jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu kutun bhai'x i'ii'ñ ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gook.
Jano' ba' gu elem gu Tobiias gu Jedaiia gu bhóogɨt gu mar gu Sepaniias jix duñia' gu jodai' na jix uam gu ux gu ñi'ook vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' aajim gu ñi'ook vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios jix maati' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan; gio ba' ka't dhi' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't oi'ñga' maakobh gu gɨ'kora' gu Dariio ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tasi' maakobh gu takarui' jix bhai'x gu Kisleu.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Saraser bɨɨx gu Regem-melek gu chichio'ñ gu suudai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' ñiokda' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan mi'p gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan bham; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' jixchamaam chulhiiñchuda' gu oi'ñga'n na ja'p gu jodai' gu ñi'ook tu' dhɨt gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan bham; na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' jixchamaam kɨɨv gu takarui' dhi' ja'tkam gu vaak gu takarui' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n na ba' tu'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk kua'da' gu chuukug cham kua'da' gu chuukug na ba' gu takarui'.

Na pai' dhuuk cham dhi' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu novɨ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan dharka' na pai' dhuuk gu Jerusalem ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux jɨ'dɨlh xikoolh saagi'ñ vaak ja'tkam oi'ñka'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tasi' bham.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jir bhai' jir bɨx bhai' xoi'kam xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch jix duñia' bɨɨx xibhɨk.
Jano' ba' cham gu takarui' ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam tu' ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam tu' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr tu' gampai'; gio ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug cham bhai' gu i'ii'ñ bhaan xibhɨk.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook cham jix duñia' jix kai va'k jix maa gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' maatɨt na ba' cham gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu i'ii'ñ na ja'p jodai na jix kavɨk na ba' cham gu bhóogɨt ñi'ook na tu a'ga tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu ux gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu ux gu novɨ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan dharka'; gio ba' ka't gu ux gu jodai' gu ñi'ook jix gɨ' sɨlhka'n gu ux gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p tu ñi'ook cham jix duñia' tu' cham gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.

Jano' ba' va'k gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ux bɨx chɨbɨɨp cham jix maati' gu oidha' ka't gu takarui' bhaan cham gu bhóogɨt jum duu tu' gu suudai'; na gu' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ bham.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Sioon bɨɨx jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx jix gɨ' gu vaak gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu suudai' gu Sioon jix koi tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jerusalem; mi' dhɨr gu Jerusalem tɨɨt gu Kiudad tu'r gu kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu kavɨk jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' gu suudai' jix duñia' jix koi kɨklhi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu Jerusalem bɨɨx gu suudai' gu novɨ gu ux gu oi'ñga'n gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu vaak kiicham ka't jix bhuup gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu vaak.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' tu' dhi' gu suudai' gu vaak gu vupui gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' gu ja'tkam mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh gio ka't gu vaak vupui bhaan gu vupui tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' gu Miren tu' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu oidha' tas buusñi gu oidha' pai' jix duñia' gu tas.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jerusalem; gio ba' ka't gu ux gu ja'tkam tu' jix duñia' gu ux gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx tu'r bɨɨx bɨx bhai'.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu noobh gu takarui' gu suudai' dhi' ja'tkam gu tanoolh dhi' gu ñi'ook gu chin jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan dɨr gu tanoolh mi'x juu'ñ gu suudai' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ na ba' gu ñi'ook vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan.

Na gu' na gu' va'k dhi' ja'tkam gu tanoolh cham tu' gu bhóogɨt gu chio'ñ tu' gu bhóogɨt gu vaakax tu' ka't bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook na ba' ba'k tu' na ba' gu maa'nkar kuiñcha bhaamki'ñdha'; gio ba' tu' mi'x dhaas bɨx gu chichio'ñ bhaan duiñchu'.
Gu' gu' jano' cham gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' gu ja'tkam na ja'p mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh gu oi'ñga'n tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.

Na gu' na gu' gu oi'ñga'n gu kai' bhai'x i'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu tasi' maa'n gu i'bhɨ maa'n gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu tɨkɨr jix duñia' gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' gu ja'tkam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bɨx dhi'.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p jix bɨɨx duu mu'ai tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Judaa gu vaak gu Israeel dodhia' ka't gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham gu takarui' gu' gu bhóogɨt gu noobh.
Na gu' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; na pai' dhuuk na ja'p gu jodai' jix duñia' cham bhai' na pai' dhuuk tattat jix duñia' daak tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ cham gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem gu vaak gu Judaa dhi' ja'tkam gu tanoolh; gio ba' cham gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' dhi' tu'x jix duñia' duñia'; gio ba' tu ñi'ook tu'r bɨɨx tɨtmo; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook kiki'ñgob tu'r ñi'ook na jir bhai' bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' gu chuukug cham bhai' gu i'ii'ñ bhaan tɨtmo tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook ɨɨxi'ñdha'; na gu' bɨx dhi' tu'x gu bhóogɨt tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ bham.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' gu maa'nkar maakobh gu takarui' gu maa'nkar jixchamaam gu maa'nkar kɨɨv gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu vaak gu Judaa gu bhóogɨt gu ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam tu'r bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' gu suudai' aajim gu ja'tkam jix koi mumua'da' jɨ'dɨlh.
Jano' ba' aajim jix koi gu chuukug; gio ba' gu chuukug gu suudai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; mi' dhɨr tu' gio tu jiim.
Jano' ba' aajim mui'x gu ja'tkam jix kavɨk gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jerusalem gu suudai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh gu takarui' mambhɨɨx gu chichio'ñ bɨx ñiiñio'k chɨbɨɨp jix duñia' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook bham; na gu' gu takarui' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook na gu' gu jodai' naak gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu oidha' gu adrak gu Damasko jɨɨpi'ñka'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu chichio'ñ bɨx bopxi'ñ gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gio gu amat gu oi'ñga'n gu oidha'; gio ba' gu Tiro gu Sidoon gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook ka't.
Jano' ba' jix duu xoi'kam gu Tiro gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook jix toja jodai na ja'p oo' jix uam jodai na ja'p gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu Jawatan gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ' suudai' gu kavɨk ka't gu suudai' gu tai.

Jano' ba' gu Askaloon gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Gasa gio gu bhóogɨt; na gu' gu suudai' gu Ekroon na gu' nɨɨra ka't gu suudai'; jano' ba' gu Gasa gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Askaloon cham ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix daa gu Asdod ja'tkam mii' dhɨr tu' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu ɨ'ɨr gu chin gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ taatam gu ñi'ook gio na ba' chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios ka't na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu Judaa gu Ekroon na ja'p gu Jebuseo.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' vaak ja'tkam ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu vaak kuiñcha tu' jupaabkamu'n; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n bhaan gu oi'ñga'n; na gu' jano' gu chuukug bɨɨx gu vupui.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug jix jai' mar u'vɨ gu Sioon; gio ba' jix maa jiiñak gu jodai' mar u'vɨ gu Jerusalem; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu gɨ'kora' ɨlhdham tu' jir bhai' boosolh gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' bhaan gu ñi'ook bhaan bhuru'x gu mar gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu Epraim gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook kavaayo gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham ka't gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook bhai'x i'ii'ñ chɨbɨɨp; jano' ba' aapi' ka't gu gɨ' suudai' dɨr gɨ' suudai' jiim bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' tu' gio gu ux gu ɨ'ɨr ñi'ook na jix bhaan ka' dodhia'; gio ba' tu' jix buusñi ui'ka' gu bhóogɨt cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook ui'ka' nɨɨra; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gio gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu maa'nkar.

Na gu' na gu' gu suudai' na ba' tu' gu Judaa na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Epraim; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook gu Sioon bhaan gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook gu Grekia tu' gu bhóogɨt na ja'p gu kuchii jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios ka't buupui bhaan gu ja'tkam gu jodai' na ja'p gu tasi'; gio ba' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu suudai' gu duukam.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham jix duñia' gu jodai gu takarui' i'i jix duu gu i'ii'ñ na ja'p jix bhɨɨ suudai' u'va; gio ba' jix bhuup na ja'p gu takarui' na ja'p gu oi'ñga'n jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' u'ua'tɨda' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p kakneer gu ja'tkam; na gu' ka't gu chuukug gu oidha' na ja'p gu jodai kuruun.
Na gu' na gu' gu bhóogɨt joi'gɨ'nda' gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' tiriik jix duñia' biipibop suudai' u'va gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios dhuuk gu jodai' gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu kutun maa'n dhuuk jix duñia' gu vaas yooxi' maa'n.

Na gu' na gu' gu chuukug jix duñia' tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook jix duñia' buupui gu ñi'ook jix duñia' tɨɨtki' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu ux jix bɨɨx duu na ja'p kakneer jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook na gu' cham chooto'n bipia'dam.
Jano' ba' bhaan bipia'dam tu' gu tai gu duukam gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n chiiw; gu' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ jix duñia' kakneer gu vaak gu Judaa jix duñia' na ja'p kavaayo gɨ'x bhai' bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham gio bɨx gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p jix kavɨk gu chuukug gu suudai' bhaamki'ñdha' gu vaak; na gu' gu ux na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx; mi' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' ka't jum xibhɨ'ñ.

Na gu' na gu' tu' gu takarui' gu vaak gu Judaa nukadham gu vaak gu Josee; na gu' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook na gu' gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr ka't na ja'p tu' cham gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x; na gu' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu jiim.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Epraim na ja'p jix kavɨk jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ na ja'p suudai' u'va; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gio gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook na gu' gu takarui'; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook na ja'p jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' xoi'kam gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu suudai' gu jodai' gu maa'nkar jix duñia' tu'; gio ba' na jix do'ig bɨɨx gu ma'nkam jix duñia'.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu jodai' gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu suudai' gu Asiria; gio ba' gu jodai' gu oidha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook cham jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' chulhiiñ gu ñi'ook gu ux gu gɨ' suudai' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' bɨx gu ñi'ook gɨ' suudai' jiim; gio ba' gu ux gu Assur ka't gu o'o gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' tu' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' kiki'ñgob gu takarui' gu tai gɨ' u'u kavɨk.
Na gu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook ka't na gu' gɨ' u'u kavɨk jix duñia' na gu' gu takarui' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na gu' jix duñia' gu chuukug gu Basaan na gu' jix kavɨk gu kavɨk gu o'o.
Na gu' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug bipia'dam na gu' gɨ'x bhai' gu takarui'; na gu' gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na gu' gu ux gu Jordaan gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook kakneer gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' mu'aa jugi cham ko'kmarak gu ux jix duñia'; gio ba' gu tanoolh chɨtda; mi' dhɨr gu takarui' ka't gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' tu' bipia'dam ko'kmarak jix duñia'.

Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' cham gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' jix koi gu oidha' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu suudai' tu' kapbhai' gu chichio'ñ gu novɨ duiñchu' gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu oidha' tu' cham gu ñi'ook gu noobh.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook kakneer gu ja'tkam maachim bia' kakneer; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gook gu jodai'; mi' dhɨr maa'n gu takarui' gu ux gu tɨɨgɨ' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook kakneer.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n kooda' vaik bipia'dam gu takarui' gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' gu ux gio gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' tu'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham gu suudai'; na gu jodai'; jano' ba' gu takarui'; gio ba' gu jodai' jugi gu chuukug gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu suudai' na ba' gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu jodai' bɨɨx bɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' ka't gu suudai' gu takarui' gu tanoolh jix maati' bia' kakneer gu bhóogɨt tu' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr tu' cham tɨtda:―Cha'pim; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook jix toja jodai.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam jix duñia' u'uuk bɨɨx jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook jix toja jodai mi'x juu'ñ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Judaa gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook gu duukam bipia'dam gu ñi'ook.

Na gu' na gu' gu suudai' tu' gu oi'ñga'n bipia'dam gu oidha' cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook cham gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n cham jix duñia' gu suudai' tu' jix duñia' gu suudai' gu chuukug; gu' gu ñi'ook jugi gu chuukug gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n.

Jano' ba' cham bhai' ka't bipia'dam cham tu' gu ñi'ook gu vaakax; gio ba' gu kuchii bhaan gu ñi'ook bhaan gu vupui gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr bɨx jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' ka't gu vupui gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios muuk gu tɨkɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' duñia' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk gu suudai' tu' jix duñia' gu Jerusalem gu ux vaaso gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' bɨx gu ja'tkam xikoolh na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Judaa bhaan gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' ka't mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tu' gu bhóogɨt gu Jerusalem gu ux gu jodai gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu ja'tkam; gio ba' bɨx gu takarui' ka't gu takarui' xoi'kam bɨx chɨbɨɨp gu oidha' jix duñia' bhaan.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bɨx kavaayo bɨɨx gu suudai' jix tɨ'ɨ; gu' bhaan gu vaak gu Judaa bhi'spio'kai gu vupui bɨx kavaayo gu ja'tkam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Judaa gu chuukug gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu kavɨk jix koi gu Jerusalem gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu Judaa na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu tai gu u'u na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu tai gu suudai'; gio ba' gu takarui' kɨɨ'n gu jodai' bɨx gu ja'tkam xikoolh; mi' dhɨr gu Jerusalem ka't jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ pai' gu Jerusalem.
Na gu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios vaak zel gu Judaa maa'n na gu' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu vaak gu Dabii jix koi gu Jerusalem cham gu jodai' bhaan gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix koi gu Jerusalem; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't gu takarui' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook ka't na ja'p gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr gu vaak gu Dabii na ja'p daada' na ja'p nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' ka't mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tu' gu jodai' bɨx chɨbɨɨp gu bhóogɨt bhaan gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bhaan gu vaak gu Dabii bhaan jix koi gu Jerusalem gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ nɨidhidha' soi'm; gio ba' jix duñia' tu' bhaan jix duu gu ñi'ook bhaan na ja'p gu ñi'ook bhaan maa'n gu oi'ñga'n bhaan na ja'p gu ñi'ook bhaan maa'nkam mar.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu Adadrimoon gu suudai' gu Megiddo.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu ux; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu vaak gu Dabii gu ux gu u'vɨ gu ux; mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu vaak gu Nataan gu ux gu u'vɨ gu ux.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu vaak gu Lebii gu ux gu u'vɨ gu ux; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Simei gu ux gu u'vɨ gu ux.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux gu u'vɨ gu ux.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook jix kupi'ook na ba' gu vaak gu Dabii na ba' jix koi gu Jerusalem na ba' uañi'ñ gu vaak.

Jano' ba' ka't mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu chuukug cham pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n aajim chɨ'ñchoka'; gio ba' gio gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu oidha' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu vaak.

Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug gu taat gu naan jix mar; na gu' cham ii'mdagaram na gu' tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios; na pai' dhuuk gu taat gu naan jix mar jix duñia' na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n.

Na pai' dhuuk ka't mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' tu' cham pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jix bhai'x na ba' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug; gio ba' cham jix duñia' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; mi' dhɨr tu juan jix duñia' gu oidha'; na gu' dhi' gu jodai' gu chio'ñ dɨr gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu suudai' gu noobh tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx jix duñia' gu jodai' gu vaak gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' bamii' gu ñi'ook gu kuchii bhaan bipia'dam bhaan gu chio'ñ duiñchu' gu chuukug tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' gu takarui' bipia'dam jix duñia' kakneer; gu' gu jodai' gu novɨ bhaan gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' bɨx gu oidha' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gook gu bhóogɨt ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai'; gu' gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu tai gu i'ii'ñ baasɨ'n gu chuukug na ja'p gu jodai' jix toja jodai gu jodai' na ja'p gu maa'nkar jix uam jodai; gio ba' jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' tu' tu jiim gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam gu chuukug; jano' ba' gu chuukug; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios jupaabkamu'n gu takarui' ka't gu suudai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.

Na gu' na gu' tu' gu oi'ñga'n bɨx chɨbɨɨp gu chuukug bhaan gu Jerusalem; gio ba' kiicham ka't jix bhɨɨ gu chuukug ka't gu vaak gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu u'vɨ; mi' dhɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ kiicham gu ñi'ook gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam cham ka't gu takarui' kiicham.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios gu ux bɨɨx mii' dhɨr chɨbɨɨp na ja'p gu ux gu tanoolh gu chuukug.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' tɨɨt mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh bhaan gu kavɨk gu Olibas jix bhai'x gu Jerusalem baasɨ'n tas buusñi; gio ba' gu kavɨk gu Olibas jix duñia' gu ux tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan tas buusñi bhaan tas gei'ñ gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt jix gɨ' gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kavɨk jix duñia' bhaan gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan saagi'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu suudai' gu kakkavɨk; na gu' gu suudai' gu kakkavɨk jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm gu asal; mi' dhɨr gu takarui' jix duñia' gu ux kuiñcha gi'ndukɨ gu tanoolh gu Ussiias gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; jano' ba' ɨlhdham gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx bɨx jɨɨgi'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu tanoolh cham gu oi'ñga'n gu tasi' gu suudai' tu' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tanoolh gu tasi' gu Jawatan Dios tu' ka't gu tanoolh tu' gu tukaa'; gu' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu xumai gu oi'ñga'n gu tasi'.

Jano' ba' gu takarui' gio mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem gu suudai' gu takarui'; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu gɨ' suudai' gu ux na tu ibai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu gɨ' suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu gɨ'kora' bhaan bɨx gu oidha'; gio ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios ka't maa'n gu tɨɨgɨ'.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu oidha' jix duñia' na ja'p gu bhóogɨt dɨr gu Gabaa bɨɨx ka'm gu Rimmoon saagi'ñ gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu chuukug ka't gu jodai' jix daa pai' dɨr ki'ñgob gu Benjamiin bɨɨx ka'm pai' ki'ñgob gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm ki'ñgob gu oi'ñga'n; mi' dhɨr dɨr bhi'ñbak gu ananeel bɨɨx ka'm gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' jix koi cham pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n ka't gu ñi'ook; gu' gu ñi'ook ka't gu Jerusalem gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' dhi' ka't gu ux bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu ja'tkam jix duñia' bhaan gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n kua' bhaan tɨɨt gu takarui' gu vupui gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ nɨɨn jix duñia' gu chin.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' jix duñia' maa'n gu novɨ duiñchu' gu novɨ mi'x juu'ñ bhaan gu novɨ duiñchu'.
Jano' ba' gu Judaa gio gu ux gu Jerusalem; gio ba' ka't gu bhóogɨt namkɨm bɨx chɨbɨɨp xikoolh; mi' dhɨr jix uam jodai jix toja jodai gu oi'ñga'n kutun jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' na ja'p dhi' ka't gu ux kavaayo gu jodai' jix ai gu ñi'ook bɨx gu vaakax mii' dhɨr ja'tkam vaak ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu jodai' chɨbɨɨp tɨɨtɨs bhaan gu Jerusalem jix tɨ'ɨ oi'ñga' jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' ja'tkam vaak gu oidha' cham jix tɨ'ɨ gu Jerusalem jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ cham ɨlhdham bhaan dhuuk.

Jano' ba' tu' ja'tkam vaak gu Ejipto cham jix tɨ'ɨ cham gu oi'ñga'n bhaan cham gu oi'ñga'n dhuuk; gio ba' ɨlhdham gu ux bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt chɨbɨɨp cham jix tɨ'ɨ gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu kutun.
Jano' ba' dhi' ka't gu chuukug uañi'ñ gu Ejipto uañi'ñ bɨx chɨbɨɨp cham jix tɨ'ɨ gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu kutun.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bhaan vaak ja'tkam kavaayo; gio ba' jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ka't na ja'p gu chuukug vupui bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.

Jano' ba' ka't bɨx gu suudai' gu Jerusalem gu Judaa jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' bɨx gu jodai' aajim jix bhɨɨ gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr cham gu oi'ñga'n gu Kananeo oi'ñdha' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook.
